verdict.rationale: Brex's own AI agents run in the background against user-configured policies: an audit agent monitors expenses, a review agent auto-approves low-risk items and escalates exceptions, and policy rules are applied to every transaction. The evidence is marketing-level only, and it covers built-in agent behaviors rather than general user-defined automations. Third-party Zapier, Workato and Pipedream recipes and webhook primitives earn no credit. missing for 10: documentation on configuring or customizing the agents, user-defined automation triggers and schedules beyond policy rules, independent hands-on corroboration that the agents run autonomously as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Your review agent auto-approves low-risk expenses and requests, escalates exceptions, and follows up with anyone out of compliance.
Your audit agent monitors company expenses according to your internal processes and categorizes potential violations by risk level.
Let AI agents do it instantly, based on your policies and with total transparency.
Set rules for how employees can spend, what they need to document, and who needs to approve. Brex AI applies them to every transaction.
